Question 2:

Question 4:
Q4.1:
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights
           WHERE year = 2015 AND month = 5 AND day = 14
           AND dest = 'DFW'
           ")
```
737 flights flew into Dallas Fort Worth on May 14th, 2015

Q4.2:
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT dest, COUNT(*) 
           FROM flights
           WHERE year = 2015
           AND origin = 'ORD'
           GROUP BY dest
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
           LIMIT 0,10") #top 10 results
```
Of all domestic flights going out from Chicago O'Hare in 2015, the most common 
destinations were LaGuardia, Los Angeles, Dallas Fort Worth, San Francisco 
International, and Boston Logan International. This is about what I would guess
are the most popular domestic destinations. 

Q4.3:
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT dest, AVG(arr_delay) AS avg_delay 
           FROM flights
           WHERE year = 2015
           GROUP BY dest
           ORDER BY avg_delay DESC
           LIMIT 0,10")
```
The highest average delays in arrivals in 2015 was St. Cloud in Minnesota.

Q4.4:
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights
           WHERE year = 2015 AND
           (dest = 'BDL'
           OR origin = 'BDL')
           ")
```
41,025 flights went into or out of BDL in 2015. 

Q4.5:
```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT carrier, flight FROM flights
           WHERE year = 2015 AND month = 9 AND day = 26 AND
           ((dest = 'LAX' AND origin = 'JFK') 
           OR (origin = 'LAX'AND dest = 'JFK'))
           ")
dbDisconnect(con)
```
